title: Sequential Selection against an Adaptive Opponent
abstract: arXiv:2611.30006v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Selecting a strategy by testing it against an opponent is common in game-playing AI, red-teaming of language models, and safety evaluations of AI agents. In many of these settings, the opponent adapts to what it observes, so a strategy that keeps winning in practice may already have stopped working by the time it is used. Motivated by these settings, we study a player who tries strategies in practice games against an adaptive opponent, decides when to stop, and then either selects one strategy for the next game or abstains. The goal is to select a strategy that meets a target win probability while rarely selecting one that has already fallen below it. For a single strategy, we propose the Sequential Private Accumulated-excess Rule (SPAR), which accumulates evidence through a capped likelihood ratio and selects the strategy once this evidence reaches a privately drawn uniform threshold. translated_title: 针对自适应对手的序贯策略选择
translated_abstract: 通过在与对手的对抗测试中选择策略，这一做法在游戏AI、语言模型红队测试以及AI智能体安全评估中十分常见。在许多此类场景中，对手会根据其观察到的信息进行自适应调整，因此一个在实践中持续获胜的策略可能在真正投入使用时已经失效。受这些场景启发，我们研究了一个玩家在与自适应对手进行练习对局的过程中尝试各种策略、决定何时停止，然后为下一局对局选择一个策略或选择放弃的问题。其目标是在极少选中已低于目标胜率的策略的前提下，选出一个满足目标胜率的策略。针对单一策略的情形，我们提出了序贯私有累积超额规则，该规则通过带有上限的似然比来累积证据，并在此证据达到一个私有抽取的均匀阈值时选择该策略。我们证明了停止时间必须包含这样的 p…
tldr: 本文提出SPAR规则，通过与自适应对手的序贯练习对局累积证据并在私有随机阈值处停止，从而在极少误选已失效策略的前提下选出满足目标胜率的策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Sequential Private Accumulated-excess Rule (SPAR), which accumulates evidence via a capped likelihood ratio and stops at a privately drawn uniform threshold, enabling a player to select a strategy that meets a target win probability against an adaptive opponent while rarely selecting one that has already fallen below it.
